## Experience

- Fullstack AI Engineer — Entropy Systems (2023 — Present): SaaS products for ISO standards auditing; LLM integration via AWS Bedrock and agent orchestration; distributed services across AWS and GCP with Docker and CI/CD.
- Frontend Engineer — Vintra, Inc. (2022 — 2023): migrated a video analytics platform from legacy JavaScript to strongly-typed TypeScript; introduced Vite and esbuild.
- UI Development Lead — BITA GmbH (2022): led a front-end team building index and ETF analytics tools; established shift-left practices and shared component architecture.
- Full-Stack Engineer — BITA GmbH (2021 — 2022): financial applications for index construction; asynchronous event processing with RabbitMQ; REST APIs in Python and Node.js.
- Application Developer — Intelix Synergy (2020 — 2021): full-stack internal systems in Python and Node.js on Linux/NGINX.
- Software Developer (Freelance) — (2018 — 2019): Python automation tools for data processing.
